description: Brandon Strong is a husband, father, educator, and community leader committed to conservative leadership in West Michigan, strong families, and local values. With experience leading schools, building organizations, coaching students, and serving his community, Brandon understands hard work, accountability, and common-sense decision-making. He is running to listen well, lead with conviction, and help build a stronger future.
